options.label: 按货收，不多管
options.result: 未垫款，回共同线，不安排共事来访
options.label_en: Just buy the goods, nothing more

segments.prompt_en: She's still short on the detective's fee

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 一只鼓胀的布袋落在柜台上，袋口拿旧鞋带扎了两道。
lines.en: A bulging cloth sack lands on the counter, its mouth tied twice with an old shoelace.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别急着翻，我都分成三堆了。
lines.en: Don't start digging. I've already sorted it into three piles.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 解开鞋带，把东西一样样往外拿
lines.en: Unties the shoelace and lays the items out one by one

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 左边是接口和线材，右边是外壳。中间那几件，我拿不准。
lines.en: Ports and cables on the left, casings on the right. The middle ones, I'm not sure about.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿不准的放最后。
lines.en: Do the unsure ones last.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行吧。线材我剥开一截看过，里头的铜没烂。
lines.en: Fine. I stripped a bit of the cable. The copper inside isn't corroded.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这两个外壳有裂，裂在背面，不影响拆。我没往好里说。
lines.en: These two casings are cracked on the back. Doesn't matter for stripping. I'm not dressing it up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看得出来。
lines.en: I can tell.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回你说接口要看针脚。我一根根数过，弯了的单独拿布包着。
lines.en: Last time you said to check the pins on the ports. I counted every one. The bent ones are wrapped separately.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把一个小布包推过去
lines.en: Pushes a small cloth bundle across

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这包别算好货。我室友说混在里头能蒙过去，我不干。
lines.en: Don't count this one as good stock. My roommate said I could mix it in and get away with it. I won't.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 为什么？
lines.en: Why not?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，被人蒙过的人，最清楚那是什么滋味。
lines.en: Hah. Anyone who's been cheated knows exactly how that feels.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再说，你上回是按成色给的价。我要是往里塞坏货，下回还怎么开口？
lines.en: Besides, last time you priced by condition. If I slip junk in, how do I face you next time?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手撑着柜台边，指甲缝里还嵌着黑灰
lines.en: Braces her hands on the counter's edge, black grime still under her nails

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这袋我翻了两个晚上。垃圾场东头那片，味道冲得人睁不开眼。
lines.en: Took me two nights to dig through this. The east end of the dump. The stench makes your eyes water.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别那样看我。手我洗过了，洗了三遍。
lines.en: Don't look at me like that. I washed my hands. Three times.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没看你手。
lines.en: I wasn't looking at your hands.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……那最好。
lines.en: ...Good.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跟你说个数。我得凑够八百信用点。
lines.en: Here's a number. I need to scrape together eight hundred credits.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 做什么用？
lines.en: For what?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 请人查我母亲的案子。下层有个干这行的，开口就要八百，少一个子都不接。
lines.en: To hire someone to look into my mother's case. There's a guy in the Lower Level who does that. Eight hundred, not a credit less.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说先翻账，再去找当年经手的人。上层那帮人不会替她查，只能我自己掏钱。
lines.en: He'll go through the books first, then track down whoever handled it back then. The Upper Level won't dig for her. I have to pay myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 现在攒了多少？
lines.en: How much do you have?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 从外套内袋摸出一只旧袜子改的钱袋，掂了掂
lines.en: Pulls a coin pouch made from an old sock out of her inner coat pocket and weighs it

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回卖货的钱，加上省下的饭钱，五百出头。
lines.en: Money from last sale, plus what I saved skipping meals. Just over five hundred.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这袋就算全按好价收，也凑不到八百。我算过，算了好几遍。
lines.en: Even at top price, this sack won't get me to eight hundred. I've done the math. Several times.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 所以你别给我多算。货值多少就是多少。
lines.en: So don't pad it. The goods are worth what they're worth.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你要是看我可怜往上抬价，我当场拎袋子走人。
lines.en: If you raise the price out of pity, I'm taking my sack and walking out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不抬价。
lines.en: I won't raise it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼。这话我听进去了。
lines.en: Hmph. I'll hold you to that.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把钱袋攥进手心
lines.en: Clenches the pouch in her fist

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说母亲那边越拖越难查。看守换一轮班，记录就可能少一页。
lines.en: He says the longer it drags, the harder Mother's case gets. Every guard rotation, a page of the records might go missing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 照我现在这么翻，最少还得十来天。
lines.en: At the rate I'm digging, it'll take ten more days at least.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 按货收。别的你自己办。
lines.en: I'll pay for the goods. The rest is on you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行。本来也没指望谁替我掏钱。
lines.en: Fine. Never expected anyone to pay for me anyway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 十来天就十来天，我多翻几袋就是了。
lines.en: Ten days it is. I'll just dig through more sacks.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把三堆货推过去
lines.en: Pushes the three piles across.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 开价吧。
lines.en: Name your price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 卖完差多少，我补多少。
lines.en: Whatever you're short after the sale, I'll cover.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你说什么？
lines.en: ...What did you say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 只补差的那截。
lines.en: Only the shortfall.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你补的那截算借，不算给。我会还。
lines.en: What you cover is a loan, not a gift. I'll pay it back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 怎么还，你定。
lines.en: How you repay is up to you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……那先看货。中间那几件你帮我认认，我想知道自己哪儿看走了眼。
lines.en: ...Then let's look at the goods. Appraise the middle ones for me. I want to know where I misjudged.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把三堆货往你那边推
lines.en: Pushes the three piles toward you

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 开价吧，店主。
lines.en: Name your price, shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把钱倒进袜子钱袋，嘴唇动着在心里数
lines.en: Pours the money into her sock purse, lips moving as she counts

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跟我估的差不多。中间那几件，原来是我看低了。
lines.en: About what I estimated. So I undervalued the middle ones.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还差一截。就这一截，多一个子我都不要。
lines.en: Still short a bit. Just that bit. Not one credit more.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿着。
lines.en: Take it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（把那截钱塞进另一个口袋）
条子我明天带来。
lines.en:
(She slips the extra money into her other pocket.)
I'll bring you the IOU tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你抬价了。别装，我数得出来。
lines.en: You raised the price. Don't play dumb. I can count.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 多出来的那点，从你要补的那截里扣掉。账得对得上。
lines.en: Take the extra off what you're covering. The books have to balance.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 随你。
lines.en: Suit yourself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把钱分成两摞
lines.en: Splits the money into two stacks.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼。下回再这样，我真拎袋子走。
lines.en: Hmph. Do that again and I really will take my bag and leave.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 比我估的低。
lines.en: Lower than I estimated.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 盯着那包弯针接口看了一会儿
lines.en: Stares at the pack of bent-pin connectors for a while.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……行，你是行家。
lines.en: ...Fine. You're the expert.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这样一来，你要补的那截也跟着变长了。可别后悔。
lines.en: That means the bit you're covering just got bigger. Don't regret it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说了补，就补。
lines.en: I said I'd cover it. I will.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那我记下了。一个数都不会少记。
lines.en: Then I'm writing it down. Every last credit.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把货一样样收回布袋，重新扎紧鞋带
lines.en: Packs the goods back into her cloth bag one by one and retightens the drawstring.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 价谈不拢，我就不卖。
lines.en: If we can't agree on a price, I'm not selling.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 货没卖，你那句话也先别作数。我不拿整整一大笔。
lines.en: No sale, so your offer doesn't count yet either. I won't take a whole lump sum.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我回去再分一遍，过两天再来。
lines.en: I'll sort it again at home and come back in a couple of days.

options.label: 婉拒
options.result: 婉拒共事，回共同线；已垫款项仍用于调查

segments.prompt_en: She offers to work at the shop

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探那边有动静了，先跟你报一声。
lines.en: The detective's turned something up. Figured I'd tell you first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他已经在查农场的旧账了，还托人去问当年值夜班的工人。
lines.en: He took the job. He's been going through the farm's old ledgers, and he's asking around for the night-shift workers from back then.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 找到什么了？
lines.en: Find anything?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还没有。他说那份证据太完美，不像真的。
lines.en: Not yet. He says the evidence is too perfect. Doesn't look real.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他还说，母亲以前常待的旧实验室，得想办法进去看一眼。
lines.en: He also says we need to find a way into the old lab where my mother used to work.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱够他用？
lines.en: Money enough?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 够。你补的那截，一个子都没乱花。
lines.en: Enough. Not one credit of what you covered got wasted.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把一张折了几折的纸摊在柜台上
lines.en: Spreads a paper folded several times across the counter

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我欠你那截钱。光靠翻垃圾还，太慢，也说不准哪天能还上。
lines.en: I owe you that shortfall. Paying it off by scavenging is too slow, and who knows when I'd finish.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想给你干活。认货、记账、跑腿，这三样我做得来。
lines.en: I want to work for you. Appraising goods, keeping accounts, running errands. I can do all three.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 认货？
lines.en: Appraising?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上层那些布料、表壳、瓷器，我从小见到大。拿旧货冒充新的，可骗不过我。
lines.en: Upper Level household goods: fabric, watch cases, porcelain. Real or fake, new or old, I grew up around them. Nobody fools me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 线材、接口这些，你教过的我都记着，没忘。
lines.en: Wiring, connectors... everything you taught me, I remember. I haven't forgotten.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 账我也会记。母亲农场的账本，我小时候帮她抄过好几本。
lines.en: I can keep books too. As a kid I copied out several of Mother's farm ledgers for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 工钱怎么算？
lines.en: Pay?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 按天算，哪天来、做多久，我自己排。工钱里给我留够饭钱，剩下的慢慢还你。
lines.en: By the day. I set my own hours. Leave me enough to eat, and the rest can go toward what I owe you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我捡来的货还归货，别往工钱那栏里填。
lines.en: When I bring in salvage, keep it out of the wages column.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还有吗？
lines.en: Anything else?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等母亲的案子了了，我要用自己的名字回上层。
lines.en: When Mother's case is settled, I'm going back upstairs under my own name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 到时候你帮我。该找谁、该走什么手续，你在下层认识的人比我多。
lines.en: When that time comes, you help me. Who to see, what paperwork to file. You know more people down here than I do.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 行。
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就先干到案子有结果那天。
lines.en: Then I'll work here until the verdict comes in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我来是给店里干活的。母亲和她的研究，我自己管。
lines.en: You're hiring me for the shop. Mother's affairs and her research are mine to handle.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有，我可只叫你店主。
lines.en: And all you're getting from me is “shopkeeper.”

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 本来也没指望。
lines.en: Wasn't expecting anything.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，你倒是识相。
lines.en: Hmph. At least you know your place.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把纸转过来推到你面前
lines.en: Turns the paper around and pushes it toward you

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你要肯签，我明天就来。
lines.en: Sign it and I'll be here tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 店里不缺人。
lines.en: The shop doesn't need anyone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 知道了。
lines.en: Understood.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把纸折起来
lines.en: Folds up the paper.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那截钱我照样还，侦探照样查，查到哪一步我自己去办。
lines.en: I'll still repay the shortfall. The detective keeps digging, and whatever he turns up, I'll handle myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 货我还会拿来卖。你按价收就行。
lines.en: I'll keep bringing goods to sell. Just pay the going rate.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 明天开门前来。
lines.en: Come tomorrow before opening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把纸折好，收进内袋
lines.en: Folds the paper neatly and tucks it into her inner pocket.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: ...Fine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我要是迟到，你扣工钱，我认。你要是乱扣，我也跟你算清楚。
lines.en: If I'm late, dock my pay. Fair enough. But dock it unfairly, and I'll settle the score with you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 带支笔。
lines.en: Bring a pen.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 笔我有。
lines.en: I have a pen.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 店主，那截钱……谢了。就这一回，别让我说第二遍。
lines.en: Shopkeeper, that money... Thanks. Just this once. Don't make me say it again.

scenes.title_en: The Disk in the False Bottom

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺按着外套内袋走到窗口前，没看窗边的价签。
lines.en: Eleanor comes to the window with one hand pressed to her inner coat pocket, ignoring the price tags beside it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 附近有人吗？
lines.en: Anyone nearby?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没有。
lines.en: No.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探昨晚进了旧实验室。东西都被搬空了，就剩几个抽屉。
lines.en: The detective got into the old lab last night. It's been cleared out. Only a few drawers left.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他在抽屉底摸到一层薄板，撬开，里头躺着一块数据盘。
lines.en: Under one drawer he felt a thin panel. He pried it open, and inside was a data disk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把数据盘从内袋里取出来，搁在柜台上
lines.en: Takes a data disk from her inner pocket and sets it on the counter, fingertips still pinning one corner

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就是这个。
lines.en: This is it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 打得开？
lines.en: Can you open it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要密码。他试了母亲的名字，试了农场的编号，都不对。
lines.en: It needs a password. He tried my mother's name, the farm's ID number. Neither worked.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我输了自己的生日。……第一次就开了。
lines.en: I typed in my own birthday. ...It opened on the first try.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我十岁生日那天，她忙到半夜。我还冲她嚷，说她连我生日都忘了。
lines.en: On my tenth birthday she worked till midnight. I yelled at her. Told her she'd forgotten my birthday.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 盘里存着她研究营养果的记录。
lines.en: Her notes on the Nutrifruit research are on here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 营养果怎么了？
lines.en: What about Nutrifruit?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你天天卖的那种，结出来的籽是死的，种下去不发芽。每一批苗都得从上面买。
lines.en: The stuff you sell every day? Its seeds are dead. Plant them and nothing sprouts. Every batch of seedlings has to be bought from the Upper Level.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲在做的，就是让它重新结出活籽。哪一株、哪一批、结了几颗，她一页一页记着。
lines.en: My mother was trying to make it bear live seeds again. Which plant, which batch, how many seeds—she logged it all, page by page.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 做成了？
lines.en: Did it work?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最后几页写着，有一小批籽冒了芽。她在那行字旁边画了个圈，圈得很用力。
lines.en: The last few pages say a small batch of seeds sprouted. She drew a circle next to that line. Pressed hard.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 盘里还有信。帕斯泰尔公司写给她的，好几封。
lines.en: There are letters on the disk too. Several, from Pastel, addressed to her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一封还客客气气地说“暂缓”。到最后干脆叫她停手，把资料全交回去。
lines.en: The first letter politely asked her to "pause." By the last one they were telling her to stop and hand over all her records.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她没交。
lines.en: She didn't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没交。日期我对过了。最后那封信过去不到一个月，她就被抓了。
lines.en: She didn't. I checked the dates. Less than a month after that last letter, she was arrested.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 种苗是谁卖的？他们。籽要是自己能结，下层谁还掏钱买他们的苗？
lines.en: Who sells the seedlings? They do. If the plants could seed themselves, who on the Lower Level would pay for their seedlings?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这是我跟侦探猜的。没有哪封信白纸黑字写着这句。
lines.en: That's just what the detective and I pieced together. No letter says it in black and white.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 盘你收在哪？
lines.en: Where do you keep the disk?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 贴身带着。放房间里不行，我室友翻东西从来不打招呼。
lines.en: On me. Can't leave it in my room—my roommate goes through my things without asking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这东西我谁也不给。只要上层那帮人拿到手，母亲对他们就一点用都没有了。
lines.en: I'm not giving this to anyone. The moment those Upper Level people get their hands on it, my mother's worth nothing to them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就少跟人提。
lines.en: Then don't talk about it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 除了侦探，我只跟你说过。
lines.en: Besides the detective, I've only told you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把盘塞回内袋，隔着布按了按
lines.en: Tucks the disk back into her inner pocket and presses it through the fabric

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你也一样。
lines.en: Same goes for you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今天的活照干？
lines.en: Still working today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 照干。账本给我，昨天收的那几件旧货，来历我还没写完。
lines.en: Still working. Give me the ledger. I haven't finished writing up where yesterday's old pieces came from.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 翻开账本，笔尖停在纸上没落下去
lines.en: Opens the ledger; the pen hovers over the page for a long time

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……店主，她把盘藏进夹层那天，是不是已经知道自己要出事了？
lines.en: ...Shopkeeper, the day she hid the disk in that compartment—did she already know something was coming?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先写账。
lines.en: Do the ledger first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行吧。写就写。
lines.en: Fine. I'm writing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口外来了个男人，视线没往货架上落，胳膊直接搭在柜台上。
lines.en: A man comes to the window without looking at the shelves and leans his arm straight on the counter.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 这店你说了算？
lines.en: You the shopkeeper?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要什么？
lines.en: Buying something?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 不买东西。来让你传个话。
lines.en: No. I need you to pass along a message.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 你店铺里有个从上边下来的丫头，平日里替你认货记账。
lines.en: You've a girl from upstairs who appraises goods and keeps the books.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她今天没在。
lines.en: She's not in today.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 正因她不在，我才这时候过来。
lines.en: I know. That's why I picked now.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 她那里有块盘，从旧实验室带出来的。
lines.en: She's got a disk. Came out of the old lab.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 让她交出来。东西给我，我告诉她去哪儿换人。
lines.en: Tell her to hand it over. She gives it to me, I tell her where the exchange happens.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不交呢？
lines.en: And if she doesn't?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 她母亲还在里面关着。里头的伙食、台阶、夜里当值的，没一个靠得住。
lines.en: Her mom's still locked up in there. The food in there, the stairs, the night guards—none of it's all that reliable.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 摔一跤，闹几天肚子，到那时谁分得清怎么回事。
lines.en: A slip and a fall, a bad stomach... who's to say what really happened?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 谁差你来的？
lines.en: Who sent you?

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 别多问。问了也白问，我不会说。
lines.en: Don't pry. Ask all you want, I won't tell.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 从衣兜里掏出一沓信用点，拍上柜台。
lines.en: He pulls a stack of credits from his pocket and slaps it on the counter.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 三百，替我带句话。
lines.en: Three hundred. Pass on a message for me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这钱来路不明，我不接。
lines.en: I don't take money I can't trace.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 那你就让它搁着。
lines.en: Then leave it there.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 照原话，一个字别改。听清楚——
lines.en: Word for word. Don't change a thing. Listen up—

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: “盘交出来，人就放出来。拖久了，她母亲还能不能出来，不好讲。”
lines.en: "Hand over the drive, and she walks. Keep stalling, and whether her mother ever gets out is anyone's guess."

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记下了。
lines.en: Got it.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 三天。三天之后我再跑一趟。
lines.en: Three days. I'll be back in three days.

lines.speaker: Thug
lines.text: 别动找治安部的念头。那里台子后头坐的人，话比你还快。
lines.en: Don't bother going to Security. Whoever's behind that counter talks faster than you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 伸指敲了敲那叠钱。
lines.en: He taps the stack with a finger.

options.label: 交盘换人
options.result: 交盘换人：研究归还，母亲获释，流放下层

options.label: 立即公开
options.result: 立即公开：母亲死亡，进入革命军线

segments.prompt_en: Eleanor's plan to save her mother

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那叠信用点还压在柜台角上，一张都没动过。
lines.en: The stack of credits still sits at the corner of the counter, untouched.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这是什么钱？你今天还没开张吧。
lines.en: What's this money? You haven't even made a sale today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有人留下的。让我给你带句话。
lines.en: Someone left it. Had me pass you a message.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: ...Go on.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: “盘交出来，人就能出来。拖着不交，她妈还出不出得来，就难说了。”
lines.en: "Hand over the drive, and she walks. Keep stalling, and whether her mother ever gets out is anyone's guess."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再说一遍。一个字都别漏。
lines.en: Say it again. Every word.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text:
（又说了一遍，一字不差）
三天以后，他还会来。
lines.en:
(Repeats it, word for word)
He'll be back in three days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，连我的盘在哪儿都知道。侦探才拿到手几天？
lines.en: Ha. They even know where my drive is. The detective's barely had it a few days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他还说什么了？
lines.en: What else did he say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说里头的饭、楼梯、值夜的人都不靠得住。还叫我别去找治安部。
lines.en: That the food, the stairs, the night guards in there—none of it's safe. And told me not to go to Security.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这三百呢？
lines.en: And the three hundred?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 跑腿钱。我没收，他硬放下的。
lines.en: Errand money. I refused. He left it anyway.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手指碰了碰那叠钱，又缩了回去
lines.en: Touches the stack, then pulls her hand back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他们拿三百块，买我母亲一条命。
lines.en: Three hundred. That's their price for my mother's life.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我得想想。你别插嘴。
lines.en: I need to think. Don't interrupt.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一，把盘给他们，换她出来。研究就没了，她这么多年白干。
lines.en: One: give them the drive, get her out. The research is gone, and all her years were for nothing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 二，现在就把盘里的东西抖出去，让所有人都看见。痛快是痛快，可她人还在里头。
lines.en: Two: dump everything on the drive now, let the whole world see. Satisfying, sure, but she's still in there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 三……把这句威胁递上去，申请给她换个看得住的地方，盘先留在我手里。
lines.en: Three... take this threat up the chain, request she be moved somewhere secure, and keep the drive myself for now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第三条得有人去递。那个人手里得有点东西，说话才有人听。
lines.en: Option three needs someone to deliver it. Someone with leverage, or no one listens.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回那箱货，是我报的治安部。经手的人我认得。
lines.en: That crate last time—I reported it to Security. I know the guy who handled it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他们说那边有人嘴快。
lines.en: They said someone there has a loose mouth.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不找柜台，找上回来带走箱子的那个人。
lines.en: I won't go to the counter. I'll go to the man who took the crate.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 盯着那叠钱看了很久
lines.en: Stares at the stack of credits for a long time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我自己定。
lines.en: ...I'll decide myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 交盘。研究让他们拿走，我只要她活着出来。
lines.en: Hand over the drive. Let them have the research. I just want her out alive.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她出来以后回不了上层，就跟我住在下面。这个账我认了。
lines.en: Once she's out, she can't go back to the Upper Level. She'll live down here with me. I'll pay that price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 三天后，我把话回给他。
lines.en: In three days, I'll give him my answer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 全都抖出去。信、研究、日期，让整个空间站的人都看见。
lines.en: Expose all of it. The letters, the research, the dates. Let the whole station see.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他们拿她来逼我，我就让他们再也藏不住。
lines.en: They used her to force my hand. So I'll make sure they can never hide again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你想清楚了。
lines.en: Be sure about this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 想清楚了。别拦我。
lines.en: I'm sure. Don't stop me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 申请保护。研究我不交，人我也要。
lines.en: Request protection. I keep the research, and I get her back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 威胁记录你去递。他说的原话写下来，几点来的、长什么样，都写上。
lines.en: You file the threat report. Write down his exact words, what time he came, what he looked like.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这三百一起送过去，当证据。
lines.en: Send these three hundred credits along with it, as evidence.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好。一张都别动。
lines.en: Fine. Don't touch a single bill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有，替我问清楚。母亲能不能换到有人看着的地方，不跟原来那些值夜的人碰面。
lines.en: And ask for me: can Mother be moved somewhere supervised, away from the old night staff?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我问。
lines.en: I'll ask.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 盘我留着。等案子复核，我亲手交上去，不经过任何中间人。
lines.en: I'm keeping the drive. When the case is reviewed, I'll hand it over myself. No middlemen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 撕下一页账纸递过来
lines.en: Tears off a ledger page and hands it over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 记录我来写。你出门之前，看一眼我有没有写错字。
lines.en: I'll write the report. Before you head out, check it for mistakes.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 写吧。
lines.en: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她扶住窗边的凳子。
lines.en: She comes to the window and sits on the stool outside.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让我先坐一下，腿是软的。
lines.en: Let me sit a minute. My legs feel weak.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 治安部来过人了？
lines.en: Security came by?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 来过。你送去的记录他们收了，那三百也装进袋子封起来了。
lines.en: They did. They took the report you sent, and bagged and sealed the three hundred.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨天下午，母亲转出去了。换到一处有专人看顾的地方，原来值夜的人碰不到她。
lines.en: Yesterday afternoon, Mother was transferred. Somewhere with a dedicated guard. The old night staff can't reach her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 人呢？
lines.en: And her?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没事。经手的人让我看了一张字条，是她的字，写着“我很好，别乱跑”。
lines.en: She's fine. The officer showed me a note in her handwriting: "I'm fine. Don't do anything rash."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 字写得歪。她一急就歪。
lines.en: The writing was crooked. It always goes crooked when she's anxious.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 案子呢？
lines.en: The case?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没结。只说还要重新查，什么时候有结果，谁都不给准话。
lines.en: Still open. They just said it'll be reviewed. Nobody will say when.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 盘我还贴身带着。他们说等重新查那天，让我自己带过去。
lines.en: I still keep the drive on me. They said to bring it in myself on review day.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那人没再来。
lines.en: He hasn't been back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，你也数着日子呢。
lines.en: Heh. So you've been counting the days too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 侦探说那边已经有人去问过话了，他大概不敢再往这条街上凑。
lines.en: The detective says someone's already been sent to question them. He probably won't dare come near this street again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你见到她了？
lines.en: Have you seen her?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还没有。照看她的人说再等等。我等得起。
lines.en: Not yet. Her caretakers say to wait a little longer. I can wait.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（低头抠着凳子边上那道裂缝。）
前几天我差点把盘交了。你要是劝一句，我兴许就交了。
lines.en:
(She picks at a crack in the stool.)
I nearly handed over the disc the other day. If you'd said I should, I might have.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跑腿、递记录，不算工钱，也不算借款。你别跟我争。
lines.en: The running around, delivering the report: that's not on my wages, and not on the loan. Don't argue with me about it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那算什么？
lines.en: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……先不算。想好了再告诉你。
lines.en: ...Nothing yet. I'll tell you once I've decided.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 站起身，把账本拉到面前。
lines.en: She stands and pulls the ledger toward her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨天那箱简单工具还没登记吧？锤头都松了，你肯定没看出来。
lines.en: You haven't logged yesterday's tools, have you? Bet you missed that loose hammerhead.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 看出来了。
lines.en: I noticed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你倒是写上啊。一页白纸，摆给谁看。
lines.en: Then write it down. A blank page—who's that for?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 来到窗口前的女人头发拢得整整齐齐，袖口磨得起了毛。
lines.en: The woman at the window has her hair neatly arranged and frayed cuffs.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你好，老板。我是索菲娅，埃莉诺的母亲。
lines.en: Hello. I'm Sophia, Eleanor's mother.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 看护那边准我出来一个钟头，买点要用的东西。陪我来的人在外头等着。
lines.en: The care facility gave me an hour out to buy a few things. My escort's waiting outside.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要什么？
lines.en: What do you need?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 日用品。杯子、灯、擦洗的东西。那边配的灯，一到夜里就闪。
lines.en: Daily goods. A cup, a lamp, something for cleaning. The lamp they gave me flickers every night.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你先说说毛病。哪件有裂，哪件用不长，我宁可先知道。
lines.en: Tell me the flaws first. What's cracked, what won't last. I'd rather know up front.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这只杯子底有个磕口，不漏水。
lines.en: This cup's got a chip on the bottom. Doesn't leak.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 能用就行，我不挑好看。
lines.en: If it works, it's fine. I'm not picky about looks.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 在里头待久了，站着挑东西都觉得费劲。
lines.en: After so long in there, even standing to shop wears me out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 钱我身上带得不多，挑几件要紧的。账我自己算，你按平常的价来。
lines.en: I didn't bring much money, so just the essentials. I'll do my own math. Charge your usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 按价签。
lines.en: Price tags apply.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她说过你这一点。说你这儿价签贴得歪，开出来的价却不歪。
lines.en: She told me that about you. Your price tags are crooked, but your prices aren't.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她常说话。
lines.en: She talks a lot.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她的话从来不少。小时候不说话就唱，唱得满屋子都是。
lines.en: She always has. As a girl, when she wasn't talking, she was singing. Filled the whole house.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 唱歌？
lines.en: Singing?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 学过几年。嗓子不坏，老师也夸过她。后来大了，嫌被人听见丢面子，就不唱了。
lines.en: She took lessons for a few years. Decent voice—her teacher praised her. Then she grew up, got embarrassed at being overheard, and stopped.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你可别去问她，回头她要怪我多嘴。
lines.en: Don't ask her about it. She'll say I couldn't keep my mouth shut.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 研究的事，我听说了。盘还在她手里。
lines.en: I heard about the research. She still has the drive.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我本来想过，那东西交出去也就交出去了，只要她能在上面好好过日子。
lines.en: I'd thought: let it go, hand it over. As long as she could live well up there.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她没这么选。这点倒是随我，倔。
lines.en: She didn't choose that. She gets that from me. Stubborn.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 东西挑好了？
lines.en: Picked your things?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text:
杯子、灯，再拿一样擦洗用的。（把挑好的几件推到柜台中间）
就这些。
lines.en:
The cup, the lamp, and one cleaning item. (Pushes the chosen items to the middle of the counter)
That's all.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别看我是她母亲，就少算我的钱。该多少是多少。
lines.en: Don't charge me less because I'm her mother. Whatever it costs, it costs.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 过来看价。
lines.en: Come look at the price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 价钱和我心里算的差不多。
lines.en: About what I figured.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把杯子揣进怀里
lines.en: Tucks the cup into her coat.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 灯今晚就能换上。
lines.en: The lamp goes in tonight.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 谢谢你，老板。东西结实，用得住。
lines.en: Thank you, shopkeeper. Solid goods. They'll last.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你少算了。我看得出来。
lines.en: You undercharged me. I can tell.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这回我先收下。下次再来，你按价签算，别让我站在这儿跟你争。
lines.en: I'll accept it this time. Next time, go by the tags. Don't make me stand here arguing with you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 比价签上写的多了一截。
lines.en: That's a fair bit over the tag.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 停了一下，还是把钱付了
lines.en: Pauses, then pays anyway.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我女儿在你这儿记账。这笔账，你最好别让她看见。
lines.en: My daughter keeps your books. You'd better not let her see this one.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 没谈拢就算了。东西你收好，我去别处看看。
lines.en: No deal, then. Keep your goods. I'll look elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把杯子推回柜台中间
lines.en: Pushes the cup back to the middle of the counter.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那边的灯，再忍几天也行。
lines.en: I can live with that lamp a few more days.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 来到窗口前的女人头发拢得整整齐齐，袖口磨得起了毛。
lines.en: The woman at the window has her hair neatly arranged and frayed cuffs.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你好，老板。我是索菲娅，埃莉诺的母亲。
lines.en: Hello. I'm Sophia, Eleanor's mother.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 前两天刚搬下来，跟她挤在配给站对面那间屋子。今天来买点要用的东西。
lines.en: I moved down a couple of days ago. We share that room opposite the ration station. I'm here to buy a few necessities.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要什么？
lines.en: What do you need?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 日用品。杯子、灯、擦洗的东西。屋里那盏灯，一到夜里就闪。
lines.en: Household goods. A cup, a lamp, cleaning things. The lamp in our room flickers all night.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你先说说毛病。哪件有裂，哪件用不长，我宁可先知道。
lines.en: Tell me the flaws first. What's cracked, what won't last. I'd rather know up front.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这只杯子底有个磕口，不漏水。
lines.en: This cup's got a chip on the bottom. Doesn't leak.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 能用就行，我不挑好看。
lines.en: If it works, it's fine. I'm not picky about looks.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 在里头待久了，站着挑东西都觉得费劲。
lines.en: After so long in there, even standing to shop wears me out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 钱我身上带得不多，挑几件要紧的。账我自己算，你按平常的价来。
lines.en: I didn't bring much money, so just the essentials. I'll do my own math. Charge your usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 按价签。
lines.en: Price tags apply.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她说过你这一点。说你这儿价签贴得歪，开出来的价却不歪。
lines.en: She told me that about you. Your price tags are crooked, but your prices aren't.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她常说话。
lines.en: She talks a lot.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她的话从来不少。小时候不说话就唱，唱得满屋子都是。
lines.en: She always has. As a girl, when she wasn't talking, she was singing. Filled the whole house.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 唱歌？
lines.en: Singing?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 学过几年。嗓子不坏，老师也夸过她。后来大了，嫌被人听见丢面子，就不唱了。
lines.en: She took lessons for a few years. Decent voice—her teacher praised her. Then she grew up, got embarrassed at being overheard, and stopped.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你可别去问她，回头她要怪我多嘴。
lines.en: Don't ask her about it. She'll say I couldn't keep my mouth shut.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 研究的事，我听说了。盘已经交回去了。
lines.en: I heard about the research. The drive has been handed back.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我本来想过，那东西交出去也就交出去了，只要她能在上面好好过日子。
lines.en: I'd thought: let it go, hand it over. As long as she could live well up there.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她选了让我出来，自己留在下面。这点倒是随我，倔。
lines.en: She chose to get me out and stay down here herself. She's like me in that respect. Stubborn.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 东西挑好了？
lines.en: Picked your things?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text:
杯子、灯，再拿一样擦洗用的。（把挑好的几件推到柜台中间）
就这些。
lines.en:
The cup, the lamp, and one cleaning item. (Pushes the chosen items to the middle of the counter)
That's all.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别看我是她母亲，就少算我的钱。该多少是多少。
lines.en: Don't charge me less because I'm her mother. Whatever it costs, it costs.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 过来看价。
lines.en: Come look at the price.

segments.prompt_en: Did she get the coat's story right?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗口后那排旧货架照她说的换过摆法，每一格前头都压着一张手写小纸条。
lines.en: The shelves behind the window have been rearranged as she suggested, a handwritten note in front of each compartment.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先别看货。先看纸条。
lines.en: Don't look at the goods yet. Read the notes first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回你说我讲旧货，要么讲成谁家的惨事，要么干脆只报个数。我琢磨了两天。
lines.en: Last time you said I either turn old goods into someone's tragedy or just quote a number. I chewed on that for two days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这回按人摆。同一个人送来的占一格，同一种来历排一行。
lines.en: So now it's sorted by person. One slot per seller, one row per kind of origin.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（指着最上面那格）
最上面这格全是修船坞那位老伯的。他手上常年沾油，件件都留着印子。
lines.en:
(Points at the top slot)
This whole slot is from the old man who fixes boats at the dock. His hands are always oily. Every piece has his prints.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 中间这排是搬家清出来的。日用品多，杯子、灯罩、刷子。
lines.en: The middle row came from move-out clearances. Mostly household stuff: cups, lampshades, brushes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最底下是拾荒来的。我那几袋单独一格，账另记，不跟店里的混。
lines.en: The bottom row is scavenged. My own bags get their own slot and their own ledger. Don't mix them with the shop's.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 账呢？
lines.en: The ledger?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 记了。每件后头都写着谁拿来的、哪一天、怎么来的。看不出来历就画个问号，不瞎编。
lines.en: Done. Each item lists who brought it, when, and how. If I can't tell where it came from, I put a question mark. I don't make things up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 刚才那位客人。
lines.en: That customer just now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你瞧见了啊。
lines.en: ...So you saw.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你把那件灰外套递给他，他摸那块补丁摸了半天。
lines.en: You handed him that gray coat. He kept touching the patch, so I told him about it from beside the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我自己给他讲的，从头讲到尾。
lines.en: I didn't wait for you. I told him myself, start to finish.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 讲了什么？
lines.en: Told him what?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 接过店主递出的灰外套，摊在柜台上
lines.en: Takes the gray coat the shopkeeper passes out and spreads it on the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就这件。这一排里我最喜欢它。
lines.en: This one. It's my favorite in the whole row.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你看右边袖肘。补了三回，线色一回比一回浅。
lines.en: Look at the right elbow. Patched three times, and the thread gets lighter each time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一回针脚密，第二回松了些，第三回手法全变了，换了个人补的。
lines.en: The first stitches are tight, the second a bit looser. The third is a different technique entirely. Someone else patched it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 送它来的大姐说过，这是她丈夫穿了好些年的。后来他腿脚不行，外套就给了儿子。
lines.en: The woman who brought it said her husband wore it for years. When his legs gave out, the coat went to their son.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟客人讲的也就这些。没说谁可怜，也没报它值多少。
lines.en: That's all I told him. I didn't say anyone was pitiful, or what it's worth.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他听完，又摸了摸那块补丁，说下回带他女人一起来看。
lines.en: When I finished, he touched the patch again and said he'd bring his wife next time to see it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手按在外套领子上，没往回收
lines.en: Keeps her hand on the coat's collar.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……店主，你看一眼。我讲的那些，有没有哪里不对。
lines.en: ...Shopkeeper, take a look. Did I get anything wrong?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 讲得好。
lines.en: Well told.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少来。你夸人从不超过三个字。
lines.en: Please. Your praise never runs past three words.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把外套往他那边推了推
lines.en: Pushes the coat toward him.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那第三回是谁补的，你倒是说说看？
lines.en: Then you can tell me who did the third patch, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那个儿子。左手拿的针。
lines.en: The son. Left-handed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 点了一下头
lines.en: Nods once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 点头算什么。我讲了那么半天，你就回我一个点头？
lines.en: A nod? I talked all that time and you give me a nod?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第三回是那个儿子补的。针脚往左斜。
lines.en: The son did the third patch. The stitches slant left.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你早看出来了，还光点头。
lines.en: ...You knew all along and just nodded.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……那你倒是早说。我跟人家讲"换了个人"，讲得跟猜谜一样。
lines.en: ...Then you could've said so. I told the man "someone else" like I was posing a riddle.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 拉过台上的账本，翻到那页，把一个问号划掉
lines.en: Pulls over the ledger on the counter, turns to the page, and crosses out a question mark

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 改了。下回我就这么讲。
lines.en: Fixed. That's what I'll say next time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把外套叠好递回窗口里，在外头的凳子上坐下
lines.en: Folds the coat, passes it back through the window, and sits on the stool outside

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跑了一上午腿，又讲了一通，嗓子都干了。
lines.en: A whole morning of errands and all that talking. My throat's dry.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷子里没有脚步声，窗口前只有她一个。
lines.en: No footsteps in the alley. She is the only person at the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂。这附近没旁人吧。
lines.en: Hey. No one else nearby, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没人。
lines.en: Nobody.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。
lines.en: ...Master.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 立刻把账本竖起来挡在脸前
lines.en: Instantly props the ledger up in front of her face

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 客人跟前你可别应。
lines.en: Don't answer to that in front of a customer.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好。
lines.en: Fine.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把账本慢慢放平，眼睛盯着最后一行
lines.en: Slowly lowers the ledger, eyes fixed on the last line

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……那我先写账了，主人。
lines.en: ...Then I'll do the books first, Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第三回补的人，是那个儿子。
lines.en: The third patch was the son's.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你怎么知道？
lines.en: How do you know?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 针脚往左斜，是左手拿的针。他来的时候，用左手签的字。
lines.en: The stitches slant left. Left-handed needle. When he came in, he signed with his left hand.

segments.prompt_en: How to respond to the confession

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 本子合上了。旧衣两件，工具一件，哪儿来的我都写清了。
lines.en: Ledger's closed. Logged two old garments and one simple tool today, provenance all written down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 下班吧。
lines.en: Go clock out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 笔别进账本，推回窗里，人没站起
lines.en: Clips the pen into the ledger and passes it back through the window, but stays seated

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 班我交了。这会儿，不算工。
lines.en: I'm off shift. Right now doesn't count as work.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那算什么？
lines.en: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等等。我好不容易才等到下班。
lines.en: Give me a minute. I've been waiting all shift for this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等复核下来，我也还想给你看店。
lines.en: I want to keep working here after the review comes through.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往后没工的日子，我也想来看看你。
lines.en: I'd like to come see you on my days off, too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我喜欢你。想跟你谈恋爱。
lines.en: …I like you. I want to be with you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可我还想叫你主人。你肯不肯？
lines.en: I still want to call you Master, though. Would you mind?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也是。
lines.en: Same here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……也什么？
lines.en: …You what?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。
lines.en: I like you too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（偏开脸，耳根烧起来）
这句我爱听，主人。
lines.en:
(She turns away, her ears red.)
I like hearing that, Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（怔了一下）
……头一回听你这么喊我。
lines.en:
(Freezes for a moment)
...That's the first time you've called me that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 往后在外头，我也这么喊你。
lines.en: That's what I'll call you out in the street, too.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……嗯，主人。
lines.en: …Mm, Master.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 朝柜台边又挪近半寸，袖子扫过他的手，空着的手按在账本边上
lines.en: Shifts half a step toward the counter, her sleeve brushing the back of his hand

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这本子替我记着，你不许反悔，主人。
lines.en: Then it counts from today. No taking it back, Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不反悔。
lines.en: No regrets.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她上身伏到台面上，胸口抵着木沿，跟他之间只横着那本合上的账本。
lines.en: She leans over the counter, chest pressed to its edge, only a ledger between them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 眼睛往哪儿搁呢。……看吧，我又不躲。
lines.en: Where are you looking? ...Fine, look. You're not a stranger anymore.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手指勾着他的袖口，不放开
lines.en: Hooks a finger in his cuff and doesn't let go

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有一件，只讲给你一个人。
lines.en: One more thing. Just between us.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 母亲上回买东西，是不是把我唱歌的事说给你了？
lines.en: The day my mother came shopping, she told you I used to sing, didn't she?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 提了。
lines.en: She did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，我一猜就是。
lines.en: Hah. I knew it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 学过几年，后来怕人听见笑话，就再没开过口。下来这些年，一声没哼过。
lines.en: I trained a few years, then quit. Being heard felt humiliating. Since coming down, I haven't hummed once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天理旧货，调子自己从嘴边冒出来，我自己都吓一跳。
lines.en: Sorting old stock these past few days, tunes keep slipping out. It startled me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我还想唱。等案子了了，唱给人听，报我自己的名字。
lines.en: I want to sing again. Once the case is settled, I want to sing for people, under my own name.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 唱什么？
lines.en: Sing what?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没定。歌我自己挑，谁的手都别伸。
lines.en: Haven't decided. I pick my songs. Nobody picks for me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天不唱，你别指望。……头一句也不落在这扇窗户前头。
lines.en: Not today. Don't get your hopes up. ...And my first performance won't be at this window.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我等着。
lines.en: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼。
lines.en: Hmph.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 松开他的袖口，抄起外套转到一半，又停住
lines.en: Lets go of his sleeve, picks up her coat, and turns to leave, then stops

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天我早到，主人。
lines.en: I'll be in early tomorrow, Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你倒是一口就应了。
lines.en: …That was quick.

segments.prompt_en: Respond to her wanting to audition

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 柜台边靠着一只拾荒袋，袋口用旧电线缠紧，还没拆开。
lines.en: A bag of scavenged goods stands by the counter, its mouth tied with wire, still unopened.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先别碰这袋。今天工钱照旧记，袋里的东西我迟些单独核。
lines.en: Leave that bag for now. Log today's wages as usual. I'll price what's inside separately later.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我提前来，就为趁这会儿没客人，先跟你提桩事。
lines.en: I came early to tell you something before any customers show up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 讲。
lines.en: Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我想去唱一回。上台试一次。
lines.en: I want to try once. Singing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别拿那种眼神看我。原先我是说等案子了结，可实在等不住了。
lines.en: Don't look at me like that. I said I'd wait for the case, but I can't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再这么闷下去，我怕往后连起音都起不准。
lines.en: If I keep bottling it up, I'm afraid one day I won't even find the key.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去哪儿唱？
lines.en: Sing where?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上边有几户人家常办沙龙。地方不算大，几十张椅子围一圈。
lines.en: A few Upper Level households host salons. Small rooms, a few dozen chairs in a circle.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有一位办沙龙的听过我唱。他每个月会排几个新面孔，一人上去唱一支。
lines.en: One host has heard me sing. Each month he books a few newcomers, one song each.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可我过不了那道门。入口查许可证，我的名字就在禁止回去的名录上。
lines.en: But I can't get up there. They check passes at the gate, and my name's on the no-return list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就算上得去，还得有套像样的衣服，台次名单里还得给我留一格。
lines.en: Even if I get in, I'll need something decent to wear and a spot on the programme.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 指尖按着账本封皮，慢慢划过去
lines.en: Draws a finger across the ledger's cover

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 自己提起来都觉着寒碜。
lines.en: I feel shabby just asking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可我还是想上台。你怎么说？
lines.en: But I still want to try. What do you say?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去试。
lines.en: Go for it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 说得倒轻巧。连往上走的门朝哪边开，你清楚吗？
lines.en: Easy for you to say. Do you even know where the way up is?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 歌先练稳。旁的我办。
lines.en: Get the song down first. I'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 歌早就在我肚子里。把我挡在外头的是门和台次名单。
lines.en: I could sing it in my sleep. What's stopping me is the gate and the list.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 衣服店里现成有。那身晚会礼服。
lines.en: The shop has clothes. That gala dress.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那身？你什么时候觉出它合我的尺寸？
lines.en: That one? When did you notice it'd fit me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你验货那天，在它跟前站了好一会儿。
lines.en: The day you appraised stock. You stood in front of it a long time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……谁站好一会儿了。我是在看它的缝线。
lines.en: ...I did not. I was looking at the stitching.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 许可证和台次我去办。办成再告诉你。
lines.en: I'll handle the pass and the list. I'll tell you when it's done.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你去找人，别替我讨情分。我母亲那桩案子，一个字都不许提。
lines.en: When you ask around, don't beg for me. Not one word about my mother's case.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一个字不提。只报你名字。
lines.en: I won't. Just your name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就行。
lines.en: Good.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 歌定了吗？
lines.en: Picked a song?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 定了。就是从前老师老叫我唱的那支。拍子快，高音也密。
lines.en: I have. The one my teacher always made me sing. Fast, lots of high notes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一回上台，就该用这样的歌，让底下的人听一遍就记住。
lines.en: First time up, it has to be something like that. Something they'll remember.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 只唱这一首？
lines.en: Just one song?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就一首。多唱倒显得我急着往人堆里凑。
lines.en: Just one. Any more and I'd look desperate to please.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 往巷口扫了半圈，又朝你近前半步
lines.en: Glances down the alley

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，旁边没人吧。
lines.en: Hey, no one else nearby, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没有。
lines.en: Nobody.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人，事情办妥，先来找我。我不乐意从旁人那儿听见。
lines.en: Master. When it's done, tell me first. Don't let me hear it from someone else.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 成。
lines.en: All right.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把拾荒袋拖到脚边，解开扎口的旧电线
lines.en: Drags the scavenging bag to her feet and undoes the wire tie

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我干活了。这里头有两截电线，看着还成。
lines.en: Then I'll get to work. A couple of wires in here still look usable.

segments.prompt_en: Response after her first failed performance

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 很晚了，她到窗口前时还穿着那件晚会礼服，裙摆下边沾了道灰。
lines.en: It is late when she comes to the window in her evening gown, a streak of dust along its hem.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别急着问。先让我坐下。
lines.en: Don't ask yet. Let me sit down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 伸手把裙摆一拎，侧身坐到窗外那张凳子上
lines.en: Lifts her skirt and sits on the stool outside.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这鞋生来是给人站着看的，多走几步都别扭。
lines.en: These shoes are made for standing around looking pretty. You can't walk in them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 唱完了？
lines.en: You sang?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱完了。唱砸了。
lines.en: I sang. I bombed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我按顺序讲，你别插话。
lines.en: I'll start from the top, in detail. Don't interrupt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第三个就是我。前两个唱完，下面还在聊，碰杯声一阵一阵。
lines.en: I was third. After the first two, the crowd was still chatting, glasses clinking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我这边才起声，最前排还有两个人在说谁家订婚，我听得一字不落。
lines.en: When I started, two people up front were still talking. I heard every word. Someone's engagement.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前半首还站得住。到中间那几处高音，下头还是没安静。
lines.en: I held up through the first half. By the high note in the middle, they still weren't quiet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我一急，后半首就快起来，怎么也收不住。
lines.en: So I panicked. The second half kept getting faster. I couldn't stop it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 弹琴的人跟着我赶，收尾时还错开半拍。
lines.en: The pianist chased after me, and still ended up half a beat behind.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那首曲本来该唱四分钟。我三分多便收了尾。
lines.en: That song should run four minutes. I finished in just over three.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 结束也有人拍手，只算客气。
lines.en: People clapped afterward. Very politely.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那位主人走到我边上，只讲了一句：嗓子底子还在，下回再看。
lines.en: The host came over and said the voice was still there. Maybe next time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下回再看。这几个字我小时候没少听，意思不用人讲。
lines.en: Maybe next time. I heard that plenty as a kid. I know what it means.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 真行。人在上头，脑子里就一桩事——下面多久才肯静下来。
lines.en: Heh, brilliant. Up there, all I could think was: why won't they shut up?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这歌原本是唱给谁的，我早丢干净了。
lines.en: Who I was singing it for, I'd completely forgotten.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 曲子有问题？
lines.en: Something wrong with the song?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 曲子没事，有毛病的是上台的这个人。我选它，就是想让人一次就记住我。
lines.en: Nothing wrong with the song. It's me. I picked it so they'd remember me instantly.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可它节奏太赶。我一乱，跟起来就更费力，越唱越往前。
lines.en: But it's too rushed. Once I panicked, it was in a bigger hurry than I was.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把裙摆拢到膝上，先伸手擦掉窗沿上的一点灰，才低声问
lines.en: Gathers her skirt onto her knees, wipes a speck of dust off the windowsill, and asks quietly.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人，近处没旁的人吧。
lines.en: ...Master, no one else nearby, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没有。
lines.en: Nobody.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我讲件难为情的。下了台，两只手一直抖。
lines.en: Then here's something embarrassing. Walking offstage, my hands wouldn't stop shaking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在也没停。你别看。
lines.en: They still are. Don't look.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这回长点教训没有？
lines.en: What did you learn this time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别拿上课那套压我。
lines.en: Spare me the teacher routine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……下面乱，我不该跟着乱。还有，那一首我搁下，换别的。
lines.en: ...When they get loud, I can't rush with them. And I'm dropping that song. I'll pick another.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那我换首慢的。收拾旧货那几天，嘴里老绕着的就是那个调子。
lines.en: Then I'll go slow. Sorting old stock these past few days, that old tune kept slipping out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 换支稳些的。
lines.en: Pick something steadier.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 选曲你别替我定。稳这个字，你倒说对了。
lines.en: Don't pick for me. But "steady"? You got that right.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那我换首慢的。收拾旧货那几天，嘴里老绕着的就是那个调子。
lines.en: Then I'll go slow. Sorting old stock these past few days, that old tune kept slipping out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 它没什么高音。得压着唱，下面吵也得压。
lines.en: No real high notes. I have to hold back early, and hold back when they get loud.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我定了。谁在下面开口，我就停。等那句话落地，我再接着唱。
lines.en: I've decided. If someone talks, I wait. Once they finish, I pick back up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这几天下工后，我回屋里练。你不许跟来。
lines.en: I'll practice at home after work these next few days. You're not allowed to come and listen.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那名单那边怎么弄？
lines.en: And the list?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他既说了下回再看，我就让他看下回。位置我自己去要。
lines.en: He said maybe next time, so next time he'll look. I'll ask for the slot myself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把袖口理了理
lines.en: She straightens her cuff.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手扶住柜台慢慢起身，鞋跟在地上磕稳
lines.en: Stands with a hand on the counter and steadies her heels

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下回我会正正经经走到这扇窗前，不用再提着裙子。
lines.en: Next time I'll walk up to the window properly, without holding my skirt up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好，我不看。
lines.en: All right, I won't look.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我想换首慢的。收拾旧货那几天，嘴里老绕着的就是那个调子。
lines.en: ...I want to switch to a slower one. Those days clearing old stock, that tune kept circling in my head.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷子外头过去一串脚步。她套着那件晚会礼服，站在窗边，没先出声。
lines.en: Footsteps pass in the alley. She stands outside the window in her evening gown without speaking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 店主，晚上好。账本拿给我瞧瞧，今天的工还没落笔。
lines.en: Evening, shopkeeper. Let me see the ledger. I haven't logged today's work yet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把账本翻过去两页，侧耳听了听外头
lines.en: Flips two pages, then looks up and listens

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……行，人走远了。
lines.en: ... Okay. They're gone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱完了。这回没往快里冲。
lines.en: I finished the song. I didn't rush it this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说说吧。
lines.en: Go on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还是第三个上台。下头照样有说话的。
lines.en: Third in the lineup again. People were still talking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我站在那儿没开口。弹琴的朝我看，我点了一下头，让他再等一等。
lines.en: I stood there and didn't start. The pianist looked at me. I nodded—wait.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 约莫过了三口气。那两个人自己把话收了。
lines.en: About three breaths. The two in front went quiet on their own.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 开口第一句我放得轻。后排有人朝前探身子。
lines.en: I sang the first line very softly. People in the back leaned forward.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 中间有一段又差点往前抢。我把手压到裙子侧边，按实了才稳住。
lines.en: Midway, I almost sped up again. I pressed my hand to my skirt and held it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱完那阵，台下没人拍手。我胸口一下空得发凉。
lines.en: When I finished, no one clapped. My heart sank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 过了好一会儿，掌声才起来。响了挺久。
lines.en: Then, after a moment, they clapped. For a long time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 办沙龙的那位怎么说？
lines.en: What did the man running the salon say?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他朝我这边来了。这回没提“下回再看”那话。
lines.en: He came over. This time he didn't say "next time."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他问我叫什么。上回他明明知道，这回还是要当面问一遍。
lines.en: He asked my name. He knew it already, but he asked to my face.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我报了全名，一个字没省。
lines.en: I gave him my name. My full name, every bit of it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他出了钱，请我下一场再唱一晚。
lines.en: He invited me back to sing at the next performance. Paid.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那晚的钱拿回来，我先还你一份。
lines.en: Once I get paid for that night, I'll pay back part of what I owe you first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这会儿没别人了吧。
lines.en: Nobody's here now, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没了。
lines.en: No one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人。
lines.en: Master.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 隔着窗俯低一点，礼服领口落在灯下
lines.en: Leans close through the window, the neckline of her gown catching the light

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从我站到这儿，你就一直盯着这衣服看。
lines.en: You've been looking at this dress since I got here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 台上多少人看着，我一个都没往眼里放。
lines.en: A whole room watched me onstage. I didn't care about any of them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你目光一过来，我脚底就发软。……这话你听去就听去，别笑我。
lines.en: You look, and I can't stand straight. …Just hear it. Don't you dare laugh.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不笑你。
lines.en: I won't.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手指在他手背上搭了一下，又收回来整了整肩带
lines.en: Rests her fingers on the back of his hand, then draws them back to straighten her strap

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那首歌，我今天不给你唱。
lines.en: I'm not singing you that song today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……只给你哼两句。你一句也别出。
lines.en: …Just a couple of lines. Stay quiet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 低下声哼了两句，到第三句停住
lines.en: Hums two lines softly, stops at the third

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好了，后头的先欠着。
lines.en: There. The rest can wait.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还差半首。
lines.en: That's half a song short.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 记性倒不差。先欠着吧，反正欠你的也够多了。
lines.en: Hmph. Good memory. I owe you, then. I already owe you so much anyway.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 拎起裙摆转过身，脚下顿了顿
lines.en: Lifts her skirt and turns away, then pauses

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天我照常来上工。这身我穿回去，下一场还要接着穿。
lines.en: I'll come to work tomorrow as usual. I'm wearing this home. I need it for the next performance.

segments.prompt: 她拒绝拿母亲旧案作宣传

options.label: 说她划得对
options.label_en: Say she drew the line right

segments.prompt_en: She refused to use her mother's old case for publicity

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 晚会礼服还没换，她走到窗口前，裙边沾了一层灰。手搁在柜沿上，静了几秒。
lines.en: She comes to the window in her evening gown, dust on its hem, and rests her hand on the counter edge for a while.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 店主，今天的账明天再记。
lines.en: Shopkeeper, today's figures can go in the ledger tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 唱好了？
lines.en: Done singing?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱好了。你猜里头坐了多少人。
lines.en: Done. Guess how many people were there.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 说。
lines.en: Tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 全坐满了。还没开嗓，沙龙老板就让人从隔壁又抬了一排椅子进来。
lines.en: Full house. Before I started, the salon owner had another row of chairs brought in from next door.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 刚加那排也满了。后墙根还立着几位，杯子拿在手里，半口没动。
lines.en: That row was full too. A few more stood by the back wall, holding drinks they never touched.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回在前排聊订婚的那一对也到了，今天整场没出过声。
lines.en: The two from the front row who chatted about their engagement last time came too. Not a word this time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 歌还是那支慢的。我照旧等到全场都不再动了，才起第一句。
lines.en: Same slow song. I waited again, until no one out there moved, then began.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 中间那一处，今天我没碰裙摆。不用碰，声音自己就稳。
lines.en: That spot in the middle—I didn't grip my skirt this time. No need. It held steady on its own.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 收尾了不让我下。伴奏那位凑近问，还有没有。
lines.en: When I finished, they wouldn't let me go. The pianist quietly asked if I had another.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我应了句有。他手没碰谱子，顺着我就把前奏带起来了。
lines.en: I said yes. He didn't even turn a page, just came in with me on the opening.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 多唱了一支。就是小时候老师罚我练了整整一冬的那一支。
lines.en: So I sang one more. The one my teacher made me drill a whole winter as a girl.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 加唱。
lines.en: An encore.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 是，加了。后来沙龙老板过来讲，他这地方一年到头也难撞上一两回。
lines.en: Yes, an encore. The salon owner told me later his hall sees maybe one or two a year.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 印节目单的时候，我名字那一栏就单独一个全名，前后没加任何东西。
lines.en: My line in the program had just my full name. Nothing before it, nothing after.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 人散了之后，有三个人凑来问，还在哪里唱，住哪里。
lines.en: Afterward, three people came up asking where else I sing, and where I live.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么回他们的？
lines.en: What'd you say?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱的地方，我回他们下个月还在这。住哪儿，我讲那是我的事。
lines.en: Where I sing: here again next month. Where I live: that's my business.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有位太太拿扇子点了我两下，说我脾气不小。她可一点没说错。
lines.en: One lady tapped me with her fan and said this girl has quite a temper. Hah. She's right.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 散场后，老板给我看下回的节目单草稿。我名字底下多了行小字。
lines.en: After the show, the salon owner showed me the draft of the next program. There was a new line in small print under my name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 写的是“水培农场主管之女，旧案复核中。”原样印在草稿上。
lines.en: "Daughter of the hydroponic farm director, old case under review." Word for word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他讲客人们吃这一套。把这行印上去，下回至少还得多坐两排。
lines.en: He said guests love that sort of thing. Print it, and next time we'd fill two more rows.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我要他删。他说涂掉不体面，那我就要他把全张重抄。
lines.en: I told him to strike it. He said that'd look ugly, so I made him redo the whole sheet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他问我少两排后不后悔。我答空一半我都认，那一行不准上版。
lines.en: He said don't come crying when you're two rows short. I said I'd take half empty. That line doesn't get printed.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后来他当着我面另写了一张。那行字没再出现，只留我的名字。
lines.en: In the end he rewrote it right in front of me. The line's gone. Just my name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……等出了那边的大门，腿才开始发软。
lines.en: ...Only once I was out that door did my knees give.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是下回真少掉一半，我连跟他辩的底气都没有。
lines.en: If it really is half empty next time, what do I throw back at him?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 后悔了？
lines.en: Regretting it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我悔什么。腿软归腿软，后悔是另一码事。
lines.en: Who's regretting? Weak knees and regret are two different things.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再摆一次到我面前，我照样要他删。删上两次我都没二话。
lines.en: If I had to choose again, I'd still make him cut it. Twice over.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先坐。
lines.en: Sit down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 提起裙子坐到那张凳子上
lines.en: Gathers her skirt and sits on the stool.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……坐就坐。你也不评一句我划得对不对。
lines.en: ...Fine, I'm sitting. You won't even say if I was right to cut it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行。你肯让我坐，我就当成你没觉得我做错。
lines.en: Never mind. You told me to sit, so I'll take it you don't think I was wrong.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 划得对。
lines.en: Right call.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 过一会儿那位沙龙老板出来圆场，说名字利落，印在单子上也拿得出手。
lines.en: Later the salon owner smoothed it over, said a clean name looks respectable in print.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他还说，过两天有件正事要谈，让我先别应别家。
lines.en: He also wants to talk real business in a couple days. Told me not to say yes to anyone else first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 朝巷子里扫了一眼，把嗓子压下去
lines.en: Looks down the alley and lowers her voice

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人，他们鼓掌的时候，我朝最后面那排找过一圈。
lines.en: Master. While they were applauding, I looked all along the back row.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最后一排有个跟你外套一个颜色的。我多看了两眼。
lines.en: There was a coat the same colour as yours in the back row. I looked twice.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你连我穿哪件都记得。
lines.en: You even remember which coat I wear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把裙摆提起来转过去，手从柜边拿开，又扭回头
lines.en: Lifts her skirt to leave, takes her hand off the counter, then looks back

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……下回我还看。
lines.en: …I'll look again next time.

scenes.title_en: That Page of the Old Contract

options.label: 问哪两晚请假
options.label_en: Ask which two nights she's off

options.label: 替她结掉旧约
options.label_en: Settle the old contract for her

segments.prompt_en: She settles the old contract and proposes a new one

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把账本转了个向，推到柜台靠他那侧，先翻回最前头，再用指腹把旧折痕慢慢按平。
lines.en: She spreads the ledger on the counter, flips back to the first page, and presses the old crease flat with a fingernail.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 沙龙那边给我排了日子。
lines.en: The salon's put me on the schedule.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 驻场？
lines.en: Residency?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 驻场。一个月两回，日子固定，常驻栏里挂我的全名。
lines.en: Residency. Two fixed nights a month, with my name in the resident slot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 沙龙那边往后会替我登记。门口只核对谁登台，不查那张单子了。
lines.en: He also said the salon will register me when I go up from now on. The door checks the singer, not that list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（食指点住旧约那几行）
这一页，我想今天就把它结清。
lines.en:
(Taps the lines of the old contract)
So this page—I want to close it out today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 约里写的是，等你母亲的案子出结果。
lines.en: The contract says until your mother's case is resolved.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我知道。复核没结束，我自己等；盘也还攥在我手里。
lines.en: I know. The case isn't closed. I'll wait on the review myself, and the disc's still in my hands.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在唱歌有钱拿了。这一页不用等那么久吧？
lines.en: They pay me to sing now. Do we have to leave this page open till then?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 工钱今天结？
lines.en: Shall I pay you through today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。拾荒那栏另算。
lines.en: Mm. Keep the salvage separate.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 借你的钱，下月唱完我先还一截。剩下的还按月给。
lines.en: I'll pay back part of the loan after next month's show. The rest I'll pay by the month.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后头给我留张空页吧。我还来点货记账，唱歌那两晚给我空着。
lines.en: Save me a fresh page. I'll still be here to check stock and do the books. Leave those two show nights blank for me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 按你列的来。
lines.en: Your terms, then.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 笔给你。旧账你收尾。
lines.en: Here's the pen. You close the old account.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 哪两个晚上？
lines.en: Which two nights?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 每月头一晚，和月中那晚。日子排好，我提前三天给你准信。
lines.en: The first night of each month and one mid-month. Once the dates are set, I'll tell you three days ahead.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 旧页清掉。你问完了，新的一页我来写。
lines.en: The old one's done. You're done asking—now I write the new one.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 从柜台上抽过笔，在旧约末行下面拉了一道横线
lines.en: Takes the pen and draws a line under the old contract's last line

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 结清。
lines.en: Settled.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 新一页你落笔。
lines.en: You write the next page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把账本拖近，掀到下一页落下一行，再转过去对着他
lines.en: Turns a page, writes a line, and spins the ledger around for him to see

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 写的是“店员，埃莉诺。按天记工，唱歌那两晚除外。”就这一句。
lines.en: "Clerk: Eleanor. Paid by the day, except the two singing nights." That's all.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那你平时叫我的那声呢？
lines.en: What about that other name you call me?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 笔帽按回去，目光朝巷口偏了一下
lines.en: Caps the pen and glances down the alley

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人。
lines.en: Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下月头一场，下了台我就折回店铺。账随手记掉，不压到明天。
lines.en: After next month's first show, I'll come straight back and do the books. No leaving them till morning.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我等你回来。
lines.en: I'll be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一回唱砸，我拎着裙子摸回来的时候，你这盏灯还亮着。
lines.en: The first time I sang and made a mess of it, I came back clutching my skirt. That light of yours was still on.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 账本先落在柜台边，翻到最前头那页，她把折过的地方往反方向抹了两下。
lines.en: She sets the ledger on the counter, opens it to the first page and smooths the crease back twice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 沙龙那边给我排了日子。
lines.en: The salon's put me on the schedule.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 驻场这条？
lines.en: Residency?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 驻场。一个月两晚，日子定死，牌上写我的全名。
lines.en: A residency. Two fixed nights a month, and my full name on the bill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从下次起，我上去由沙龙那边替我登记。门口只对唱歌的人，旧单子不用再翻。
lines.en: He also said the salon will register me when I go up from now on. The door checks the singer, not that list.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把旧约那几行按在掌根下，从窗口边轻轻推过来。
lines.en: Taps the lines of the old contract

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这一页，我想今天就结。
lines.en: So this page—I want to close it out today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 约里写的时限，是你母亲的案子有结果。
lines.en: The contract says until your mother's case is resolved.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我知道。案子还没结，复核我自己盯着。盘已经交回去了，母亲现在和我住在下面。
lines.en: I know. The case is still open. I'll wait for the review myself. The drive has gone back, and Mother lives down here with me now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我现在唱歌有钱拿了。这一页不用等那么久吧？
lines.en: They pay me to sing now. Do we have to leave this page open till then?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 工钱今天结？
lines.en: Shall I pay you through today?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。拾荒那栏另算。
lines.en: Mm. Keep the salvage separate.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 借你的钱，下月唱完我先还一截。剩下的还按月给。
lines.en: I'll pay back part of the loan after next month's show. The rest I'll pay by the month.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后头给我留张空页吧。我还来点货记账，唱歌那两晚给我空着。
lines.en: Save me a fresh page. I'll still be here to check stock and do the books. Leave those two show nights blank for me.

segments.prompt: 她邀请店主去上层晚会
segments.prompt_en: She invites the shopkeeper to the Upper Level gala

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把那张厚请柬推到柜台上。
lines.en: She slides the thick invitation onto the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 晚会请柬。
lines.en: An invitation.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上层有场晚会，沙龙那位老板摆的，一年只有这一回。
lines.en: An Upper Level gala. The salon owner hosts it himself, once a year.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他请的是几户有头脸的人家，驻场的也请了，我手里就来了这张。
lines.en: He invites a few families of standing, and the residency performers. I got this one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 请我去唱两首。请柬上除了我的全名，没加任何别的字。
lines.en: I'm asked to sing two songs. It's printed with my full name. Not one extra word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 老板把请柬翻来覆去看了三回，才肯递给我。
lines.en: Even the salon owner learned his lesson this time. He read it three times himself before handing it over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往底看。嘉宾位能带一位，这一栏还空着。
lines.en: Look at the line at the bottom. Guest: one permitted. Still blank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他送请柬来的时候还笑着，说我想写谁就写谁，写旧相识也随我。
lines.en: The salon owner was smiling when he gave it to me. Said write anyone I like, even an old acquaintance.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我在上头的旧相识，自我母亲出事后，好些都不认得我了。
lines.en: Most of my old acquaintances up there stopped knowing me around the time my mother's trouble started.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 笔给我。
lines.en: Lend me a pen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 抽出笔放到她手边
lines.en: Hands her the pen

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 给。
lines.en: Here.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把袖口往上折了一折，笔尖在嘉宾栏边停了一停，写下去，又涂掉，再落笔
lines.en: Writes a line, pauses, then crosses it out and starts again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好了。
lines.en: There.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我的店主。
lines.en: "My shopkeeper."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁让你念出来的。
lines.en: Did I ask you to read it out loud?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那件深色外套还在吧？收货那天，我照你的肩比过。
lines.en: You've still got that dark coat? I checked it against your shoulders when it came in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这事让我母亲听见了，她旁的没问，就问你脚上有没有一双能出门的鞋。
lines.en: My mother heard. She asked nothing else, only whether you own a decent pair of shoes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我照实说没有。她讲那你就挺直背，没人会往鞋上低眼。
lines.en: I said no. She said then have you stand up straight. Nobody looks down at shoes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你跟不跟我去？
lines.en: Will you come with me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 为什么是我？
lines.en: Why me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还问这个？名字挂在我名下，字也是我填的。
lines.en: You need to ask? That line is mine. I wrote the name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我若带旁人去，第二首唱着一半，眼神都没处放。话说到这儿，你去不去。
lines.en: ...If I brought anyone else, I wouldn't know where to look during the second song. There. Are you coming or not?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 把请柬拿起来，低头定在嘉宾那一栏上，半天没动
lines.en: Picks up the invitation and stares at that line for a long time

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还没看够？名字又不会长腿跑了。
lines.en: Still staring? The name's not going to run off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我去。
lines.en: I'll go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 到了那天你随便站，只一件，别挑最靠后的墙角缩着。
lines.en: Stand wherever you like that night. Just don't hide all the way in the back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一首我面朝底下的客人唱。第二首，你眼睛不许往别处跑。
lines.en: The first song, I'll sing to the crowd. The second one, don't you dare drift off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不走神。
lines.en: I won't.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她朝巷口偏了偏头，见近处没人，声音压低
lines.en: Glances down the alley and lowers her voice

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人。……上了楼，你可别笑场。
lines.en: Master. …Try to keep a straight face when we're up there.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不笑。
lines.en: No laughing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这张你收下。折了角我也不会替你再去讨一张。
lines.en: Keep this. If you crease it, I'm not asking for another.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那盏柜台灯没关。她已经换回女仆装，站在窗户外头，指头搭在柜沿上。
lines.en: The counter lamp is lit. Back in her maid dress, she stands outside the window with her hand on the counter edge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 回来那身礼服我挂起了，鞋也脱了。脚后跟磨掉一块皮，你别问这个。
lines.en: The gown's back and hung up. I changed my shoes too. Wore a patch of skin off my heel. Don't ask.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 杯子跟客气话都留在楼上了，我一件也没带下来。
lines.en: All those glasses, all those pleasantries up there. I left every one of them upstairs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text:
（手从窗口外探进来）
主人。
lines.en:
(She reaches in through the window.)
Master.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第二首的时候我往台下看，你那肩膀整晚都没松开过。
lines.en: Your shoulders were tense all night. I saw it during the second song.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下，手递来。今天的活归我，你一样都别碰。
lines.en: Sit down. Give me your hand. I'll do the work today. Don't touch anything.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 靠窗坐下，把一只手放到柜面上
lines.en: Sits inside the window and puts his hand on the counter

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐好了。
lines.en: I'm sitting.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 双手捧住他的手，把蜷紧的指头一点一点揉平
lines.en: Cups his hand in both of hers and slowly kneads his clenched fingers

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 僵成这样。楼上的椅子比我的鞋还难坐？
lines.en: Your hand's stiff too. Were those chairs upstairs worse than my shoes?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别这样看。这身裙子店里本来就有，你也不是头回见。
lines.en: Don't just stare. This dress is from the shop. You've seen it before.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……想瞧就瞧吧，巷子里没人。
lines.en: ...Look if you want. There's no one in the alley.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 身子往柜沿边压过去，领口向下坠了一点，指腹从手腕一路揉上去
lines.en: Leans over the counter edge, her neckline dipping as her fingers press up his wrist

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还要往上？到这儿？
lines.en: A little higher. Here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这儿。
lines.en: There.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你还挺会使唤人。（手上加重点）
lines.en: You do like giving orders. (She presses a little harder.)

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 乏了就开口。我手可以歇，在窗边陪你待着。
lines.en: Tell me if you're tired. I can stop and just keep you company here at the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这些我做得高兴。你不愿意，就直说。
lines.en: I do these things because I want to. If you don't want them, you can say no.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别停。
lines.en: Don't stop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就接着。
lines.en: Hmph. Then I won't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有半首欠着。那支老调，我上回到第三句就收住了。
lines.en: Oh, and I still owe you half a song. That old tune from last time—I only hummed to the third line.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还记着。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 手搭上他腕子，压下嗓子，从第三句往下接
lines.en: Keeps her hand on his wrist and sings softly from the third line onward

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 唱到最末一句，弯下腰把柜台灯调低一点
lines.en: After the last line, she leans over and turns the counter lamp down a notch

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 半首，还清了。
lines.en: Half a song. Paid in full.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 伏在柜沿，掌心盖住他手背，抬眼看他
lines.en: Leans on the counter edge, her palm over his hand, and looks up at him

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 主人，别的账都等明天再记。
lines.en: Master, leave the rest of tonight's accounts until tomorrow.
